label: PF Backlog 650
title: Gates: review-churn guard - disposition before re-review, bounded diff reviews per item

brief.problem: Review/fix/re-review loops are invisible; every commit changes the SHA and forces another review.
brief.why_now: EDP-10 required 8 diff reviews; discipline alone failed.
brief.success: Re-review is blocked until dispositions exist or a reasoned --rereview; completions over budget fail.

objective: Bound Gate 2.5 review churn with a disposition-before-re-review guard and a review-budget check, so re-reviews are deliberate and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: architect_review.py run --mode diff refuses a new diff review for an item when a previous diff review exists and item.review_dispositions.diff is empty, unless --rereview is passed with a non-empty --reason; the reason is stored in the evidence JSON as rereview_reason.

scripts/dev/review_churn_check.py counts diff reviews per item, prints shas/dates and an advisory warning above 2, and fails a completion in the committed diff when an item has more than 4 diff reviews unless the item carries a review_churn decision (append-only ledger); --report is a non-blocking dry run.

Tests prove the refusal without dispositions, the --rereview+reason override, the warn/fail thresholds, the review_churn justification escape and the report mode; docs/REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE.md documents one diff review per code freeze + disposition-before-re-review; precheck passes.
approach: architect_review.py: before a diff run, count existing diff reviews for the item; if any exist and item.review_dispositions.diff is empty, refuse unless --rereview --reason is given; store rereview_reason in the evidence. Add scripts/dev/review_churn_check.py (precheck gate): group engineering/reviews/*-*.json by item/mode, print a table, warn >2, fail >4 for an item completing in the diff unless a review_churn decision exists; --report non-blocking; self-test. Add pytest coverage and a REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE section.

prior_decisions: Gate 2.5 evidence is bound to the exact diff SHA (BI-PF-1469/1470); every new commit invalidates prior evidence.
One review per item+SHA unless --rereview (architect_review.py run); dispositions are main-thread-owned and keyed by sig (BI-PF-1449).
BI-PF-1479 added the decision table + overall recommendation; the HIL can see dispositions beside findings.
EDP-10 (BI-PF-1302) required 8 diff reviews because fixes were made after each review instead of batching/dispositioning.
existing_path: scripts/dev/architect_review.py: _latest_review / run / _ingest; run refuses the same item+sha unless --rereview but does not guard a new SHA with undispositioned findings.
engineering/reviews/<item>-<sha>.json (mode design|diff) are committed evidence; item.review_dispositions[mode] holds dispositions.
precheck runs architect_review_check.py for the current SHA; it does not inspect review churn.
docs/REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE.md documents the gate order but not a review budget.
assumptions: A diff review is the unit of churn; design reviews are not counted (the design is amended less often).
The budget is >2 advisory, >4 blocking at completion; a review_churn decision is the explicit HIL justification.
Only items completing in the committed diff are enforced, so legacy completed items are not retroactively blocked.
review dispositions exist before a re-review is allowed; --rereview with a reason is the audited escape hatch for a genuine blocker fix.
divergences: Enforcement sits in the review tool + precheck, not in core.backlog.set_status, to avoid a write recursion (the trail/backlog is the source of dispositions).

impact_review.evidence: Python tooling (scripts/ + test-framework); no shipped product logic.
Extends architect_review.py (one review path) and adds one precheck gate; no second reviewer/renderer.
--rereview remains; existing evidence/JSON is unchanged; only new completions over budget fail.
Review/precheck tooling only; rollback is a revert; no data/schema change.

verification: Objective achieved: Gates: review-churn guard - disposition before re-review, bounded diff reviews per item
risks: Legitimate iterative work is blocked: mitigated by the >4 budget, a review_churn decision, and --rereview with a reason.
Review files from other branches inflate the count: mitigated by counting only this item's committed evidence (the item's reviews are evidence, not branch-scoped) and a baseline/justification.
rollback: Revert the tooling commit; review evidence/JSON is unchanged.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing gate tooling: `scripts/dev/gate1_check.py` blocks re-review while any finding is PENDING disposition (CL-006 semantics); extend `core/design_guardrails.py` + review prompt to enforce findings=reviewer/dispositions=main-thread (CL-002); add churn counter (reviews per item, bounded diff scope) via existing backlog review endpoints `/api/v1/backlog/items/{item_id}/context-review`; config in `config/ci-cd-gates.json` (max_reviews_per_cycle, diff_bound lines/files).
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1469 touches `scripts/dev/gate1_check.py` and `docs/REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE.md` — coordinate edits to avoid clobbering gate-check logic
Shared files with CL-006 enforcement path; sequence after BI-PF-1469 if both modify gate check ordering
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1469 covers gate lifecycle ordering (1.5->1, 2.5->2); this item covers churn/disposition guards within that lifecycle — complementary, not duplicate
BI-0096 review/feedback ledger holds disposition status — reuse it as the disposition source of truth, do not build a second ledger
CL-006/CL-002 already document the rules; this item implements enforcement, not new policy
analysis.rationale: Enforces disposition-before-re-review (CL-006) and bounds review churn via existing gate tooling + review endpoints; reuse-first with config-driven limits, low drift.
assumptions: Review/disposition state already persisted per item (context-review endpoint exists)
Config-driven limits acceptable for tuning without redeploy
risks: Churn counter could false-block legitimate re-reviews if disposition state is stale
Bounded-diff limit may exclude required context on large items
Race between disposition update and gate check read
evidence: Correction-ledger CL-006, CL-002 enforce dispositions-before-re-review and ownership split
missing_info: Numeric bound for reviews per item/cycle (default? veto vs warn at limit?)
Diff bound size (lines/files/hunks) for a bounded diff review
Whether churn guard applies to Gate 1.5 only or both 1.5 and 2.5
